max_requests_per_client.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests allowed per client.

interface.description: Network interface name to bind DLNA discovery/response to (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0'), or 'any' to use all interfaces.

allowed_devices.description: List of DLNA device UUIDs to explicitly permit (empty = allow all).

items.description: UPnP device UUID in standard format (e.g., 'uuid:12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc')

denied_devices.description: List of DLNA device UUIDs to explicitly deny access.

items.description: UPnP device UUID (same format as above).

max_scan_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive directory scanning during content discovery (0 = unlimited).

discovery_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for device discovery and communication operations.

auto_refresh_enabled.description: Enable periodic automatic re-scan of media content.

auto_refresh_interval.description: Seconds between automatic refreshes (effective only if auto_refresh_enabled is true).

verbose_journal.description: Enable verbose logging to systemd journal (adds debug detail to syslog).
